source_provenance.method: Normal configured /usr/bin/gh contents API GET; decoded file bytes checked against response size and Git blob SHA-1, then compared byte-for-byte with local package source.
source_provenance.initial_failure: The first source read stopped at missing .cargo-checksum.json. The next explicit read retained that absence instead of claiming checksum validation.

verified_source_behavior.subject: ApiClient construction
verified_source_behavior.finding: new_sub_process calls new_narrow_version. This runs the selected executable with --version through Command::output, checks compatibility, and binds a TCP listener. Constructor timing includes this version subprocess and listener setup.

verified_source_behavior.subject: Per-call backend startup
verified_source_behavior.finding: prove_segment, lift and join each call connect. ParentProcessConnector::connect spawns a new selected executable with --port. Keeping one ApiClient per worker does not keep a proving subprocess alive across calls.

verified_source_behavior.subject: Child cleanup boundary
verified_source_behavior.finding: The normal close path calls Child::wait. The listed connection types have no Drop kill/wait implementation. Errors after spawn or before explicit close can bypass that wait. The close adapter also maps an exit status without a numeric code to zero. The proposal only guarantees joining its own scoped Rust worker threads; it cannot claim every SDK child or SDK helper thread was reaped.

verified_source_behavior.subject: Independent segment proving
verified_source_behavior.finding: prove_segment accepts options, one frozen serialized segment asset and an output mode. It does not take a preceding verified receipt. Its successful segment receipt therefore does not by itself establish an original-image prefix; ordered pre/post linkage must be verified separately.

verified_source_behavior.subject: Join claim algebra
verified_source_behavior.finding: ReceiptClaim::join composes left pre/input with right post/exit/output; it does not itself check continuity. The real recursive join merges the decoded proved claim with the expected claim. The proposal keeps explicit interval, state, left-exit and left-output checks before using the SDK composition, then verifies the actual returned seal and complete claim digest.

verified_source_behavior.subject: Complete composite
verified_source_behavior.finding: Composite integrity verifies every segment, continuation states, intermediate exit/output conditions and assumption receipts. Its claim uses original first pre/input and final post/exit/output. The proposal retains complete SDK Composite verification and equality with the original full claim before recursion.

proposal_contract.required_environment: RAYON_NUM_THREADS must be an explicit positive integer for both commands
proposal_contract.request_bounds: 1 <= WORKERS <= 4; WORKERS * RAYON_NUM_THREADS <= 8; 0 <= MAX_NEW <= 4096; actual new candidates <= remaining segments
proposal_contract.deadline: No new relative 7200-second deadline is created here. The external supervisor must retain the original absolute execution deadline and observe all descendants, cleanup and result publication.
proposal_contract.cold_recovery: An incomplete or unreadable batch completion blocks new dispatch and candidate promotion. A retained complete batch completion only permits re-reading and cryptographically re-verifying all candidate seals and the entire original-image prefix before filling missing canonical files. It never proves prior on-time business completion or authorizes payment.
proposal_contract.publication_failure: A failure after the workers and complete chain have already verified can leave a retained completion or partial canonical publication. Cold re-verification may recover those mathematical proof artifacts; it does not change the prior failed or canceled operation record.
proposal_contract.full_final_gate: Canonical full ordered segment chain, original SDK Composite full claim, actual recursive succinct proof, exact original full claim and journal, then independent strict v2 verification with caller-supplied expected artifacts.

remaining_evidence_boundaries: The initial SDK review preceded repository preflight. Subsequent source changes and validation are recorded separately; this source-review JSON is not a build, test or proof result.
Requesting eight Rayon threads in total does not establish an eight-CPU cgroup, memory bound, aggregate descendant RSS or GPU allocation.
Error and cancellation cleanup require real outer-supervisor observations because the pinned SDK has early exits without guaranteed child reaping.
The new scheduler and rejection tests cannot establish successful cryptographic generation, whole-path latency, tail percentiles, deployment readiness or post-quantum security.

Sequential and balanced measurements require separate fresh checkpoint trees, matched declared resources, all startup and loading costs, failed attempts and original-deadline publication costs. Logical 43 lifts and 42 joins are not proof that 85 fresh backend calls completed.
